```{r}
library(tidyverse)
library(readxl)
library(here)
```

```{r}
benthic_cover <- read_csv(
  here::here("data/workshop1/reef_cover_log.csv")
)

acoustic_stream <- read_tsv(
  here::here("data/workshop1/acoustic_telemetry_stream.txt")
)

fisheries_annual <- read_excel(
  here::here("data/workshop1/fish_catch_data.xlsx"),
  sheet = "Commercial_2026"
)
```

```{r}
mangrove_data <- read_csv(
  here::here("data/workshop1/mangrove_survey_raw.csv"),
  skip = 5,
  na = c(".", "NA", "9999", "ND", "blank")
)
```
```{r}
benthic_cover_df <- as.data.frame(benthic_cover)

print(benthic_cover_df)
print(benthic_cover)
```
```{r}
# Assign variable values
site_name <- "Heron_Island"
transect_depth_m <- 12.5
bleaching_present <- TRUE

# Check using function class()
class(site_name)
class(transect_depth_m)
class(bleaching_present)

# Check using function str()
str(site_name)
str(transect_depth_m)
str(bleaching_present)
```
```{r}
# Tracking the age of an old-growth Porites coral colony
years_old <- 25.765

# Round to 2 decimal places
round(years_old, 2)

# Round to 1 decimal place for the field report
rounded_age <- round(years_old, 1)

# Combine text and data
paste("Average colony age is", rounded_age, "years old")
```
```{r}
# Numeric vector
fish_lengths <- c(124, 152, 98, 221, 146)

# Character vector
coral_spp <- c("Porites", "Acropora", "Montastrea")

# Check their types
class(fish_lengths)
class(coral_spp)

# Try mixing different data types
notes <- c("Acropora", 27.5, TRUE)

notes
class(notes)
```
```{r}
# Create a list containing different data types
notes <- list("Acropora", 27.5, TRUE)

notes

# Access the first element
notes[[1]]
```
```{r}
my_dataframe <- data.frame(
  no = c(1, 2, 3),
  species = c("Plectropomus", "Scarus", "Pomacentrus"),
  present = c(TRUE, FALSE, TRUE)
)

my_dataframe
str(my_dataframe)
my_dataframe$no <- as.factor(my_dataframe$no)

str(my_dataframe)
```
